entity.name: Baldwin County Heritage Museum
entity.description: Following a community festival in 1979, a group of citizens who wanted to preserve the farming history of communities in Baldwin County founded BCHM. After opening to the public, we have continued to gain exciting items from local donations. Baldwin County Heritage Museum got non-profit status after locals donated the land. Then, we raised funds, collected items, gathered research, and opened our doors on October 31, 1987. The museum still operates as a 501 (c) (3) non-profit organization with our workforce of volunteers. If you're a history buff looking to find out what life was like for residents of the area years ago, Baldwin County Heritage Museum has a collection of awe-inspiring appliances, farm equipment, and more for you to explore. If you want a glimpse of Baldwin County, AL as it developed, then our heritage museum is the place to go. The mission of the Baldwin County Heritage Museum is to preserve the culture of the farm communities of early Baldwin County through the creation of a home for historically significant buildings, documents, and artifacts from community life. We have collected artifacts and stories from the early farming communities in the area, including tractors, wagons, appliances and clothing. When you walk through our museum, you'll feel like you're stepping back in time. When you have a small group or class of students learning about local farming history, you should schedule a private tour. Our volunteer tour guides can provide a detailed history, answer questions, and guide you through our historic buildings. After enjoying a day of education and history, you can enjoy our beautiful outside picnic space. We also have a collection of historic buildings around Baldwin County that make beautiful venues for weddings and other celebrations.

Join Today to Remember Yesterday & Be a Part of Tomorrow!

If you’re a history buff looking to find out what life was like for residents of the area years ago, Baldwin County Heritage Museum has a collection of awe-inspiring appliances, farm equipment, and more for you to explore. If you want a glimpse of Baldwin County, AL as it developed, then our heritage museum is the place to go.

Mission Statement

The mission of the Baldwin County Heritage Museum is to preserve the culture of the farm communities of early Baldwin County through the creation of a home for historically significant buildings, documents, and artifacts from community life.

Rich Local History

You can see the humble beginnings of our small towns at our history museum. We have collected artifacts and stories from the early farming communities in the area, including tractors, wagons, appliances and clothing. When you walk through our museum, you’ll feel like you’re stepping back in time.

Free Family Fun

When you’re looking for affordable family-friendly activities, we’re here to provide.

And the best part about visiting our history museum is FREE admission. We make it easy to celebrate the beauty and rich stories of the old days. Ask about our private tours on your next visit.


Historical Buildings & Venues

There are a few historic buildings and structures on our property, including a free-standing chapel for small vintage weddings. Embrace the roots of the local community and have your wedding at our history museum. Call for more information!

Be a Part of History

Baldwin County Heritage Museum is the coolest cultural attraction in the area when you’re looking for a fun afternoon. Join today to remember yesterday and be a part of tomorrow!

Celebrate Elberta’s Rich Farming History

If you want some educational fun that’s perfect for the entire family, visit Baldwin County Heritage Museum for an afternoon all about the farming history of Elberta, AL. We have a collection of tractors, appliances, and clothing from the last 40 years. Visit our historical site today!

● FREE Admission

● Volunteer Opportunities

● Wedding & Party Venue

About Us

Following a community festival in 1979, a group of citizens who wanted to preserve the farming history of communities in Baldwin County founded BCHM. After opening to the public, we have continued to gain exciting items from local donations.

Non-Profit Organization

Baldwin County Heritage Museum got non-profit status after locals donated the land. Then, we raised funds, collected items, gathered research, and opened our doors on October 31, 1987. The museum still operates as a 501 (c) (3) non-profit organization with our workforce of volunteers.

Private Tours

When you have a small group or class of students learning about local farming history, you should schedule a private tour. Our volunteer tour guides can provide a detailed history, answer questions, and guide you through our historic buildings.

Features & Accommodations

After enjoying a day of education and history, you can enjoy our beautiful outside picnic space. We also have a collection of historic buildings around Baldwin County that make beautiful venues for weddings and other celebrations.

Visit Us Today! 

From a unique farming history to intimate wedding ceremonies, there’s beauty in our local roots. Come see the unique and exciting historical artifacts and buildings at Baldwin County Heritage Museum today.
